views.name: Step 1
views.caption: Begin with the breadboard. Peel the protective backing off its underside.

views.name: Step 1c
views.caption: Begin with the breadboard. Peel the protective backing off its underside.

views.name: Step 2
views.caption: Stick the breadboard down onto F3, its red and blue rails along the same edge of F3 as its engraved code.

views.name: Step 2c
views.caption: Stick the breadboard down onto F3, its red and blue rails along the same edge of F3 as its engraved code.

views.name: Step 3
views.caption: Press the Nano Board into the breadboard: its pins go in rows c and g, columns 1 to 15, with its USB socket at column 1.

views.name: Step 3c
views.caption: Press the Nano Board into the breadboard: its pins go in rows c and g, columns 1 to 15, with its USB socket at column 1.

views.name: Step 4
views.caption: Bend the legs of both resistors down at right angles, like this, so that they fit the breadboard.
views.review: The published guide shows the legs straight, then bent; this view shows them bent only (the player cannot swap a part for another of a new shape). Enough?

views.name: Step 5
views.caption: Press a resistor into the breadboard, from the (-) blue rail to h27.

views.name: Step 5c
views.caption: Press a resistor into the breadboard, from the (-) blue rail to h27.

views.name: Step 6
views.caption: Press the other resistor into the breadboard, from the (-) blue rail to h29.

views.name: Step 6c
views.caption: Press the other resistor into the breadboard, from the (-) blue rail to h29.

views.name: Step 7
views.caption: Press the real time clock module into row j, its pins from j19 to j24, with its coin cell facing the back.

views.name: Step 7c
views.caption: Press the real time clock module into row j, its pins from j19 to j24, with its coin cell facing the back.

views.name: Step 8
views.caption: Peel six wires off the ribbon of jumper wires, one of each colour, and lay them side by side.

views.name: Step 8c
views.caption: Peel six wires off the ribbon of jumper wires, one of each colour, and lay them side by side.

views.name: Step 9
views.caption: Connect the black jumper wire from i23 to (+) red.

views.name: Step 9c
views.caption: Connect the black jumper wire from i23 to (+) red.

views.name: Step 10
views.caption: Connect the green jumper wire from (-) blue to i24.

views.name: Step 10c
views.caption: Connect the green jumper wire from (-) blue to i24.

views.name: Step 11
views.caption: Connect the purple jumper wire from a8 to i22.

views.name: Step 11c
views.caption: Connect the purple jumper wire from a8 to i22.

views.name: Step 12
views.caption: Connect the blue jumper wire from a9 to i21.

views.name: Step 12c
views.caption: Connect the blue jumper wire from a9 to i21.

views.name: Step 13
views.caption: Connect the white jumper wire from a14 to (-) blue.

views.name: Step 13c
views.caption: Connect the white jumper wire from a14 to (-) blue.

views.name: Step 14
views.caption: Connect the dark red jumper wire from a12 to (+) red.

views.name: Step 14c
views.caption: Connect the dark red jumper wire from a12 to (+) red.

views.name: Step 15
views.caption: Push the rocker switch, wires first, down into the square hole in F4 until it clicks in.

views.name: Step 15c
views.caption: Push the rocker switch, wires first, down into the square hole in F4 until it clicks in.

views.name: Step 16
views.caption: Connect the switch's red wire to j27.

views.name: Step 16c
views.caption: Connect the switch's red wire to j27.

views.name: Step 17
views.caption: Connect the switch's tan wire to (+) red.

views.name: Step 17c
views.caption: Connect the switch's tan wire to (+) red.

views.name: Step 18
views.caption: Connect the switch's black wire to j29.

views.name: Step 18c
views.caption: Connect the switch's black wire to j29.

views.name: Step 19
views.caption: Peel two wires off the ribbon of jumper wires, an orange and a yellow, and lay them side by side.

views.name: Step 19c
views.caption: Peel two wires off the ribbon of jumper wires, an orange and a yellow, and lay them side by side.

views.name: Step 20
views.caption: Connect the orange jumper wire from j1 to i27.

views.name: Step 20c
views.caption: Connect the orange jumper wire from j1 to i27.

views.name: Step 21
views.caption: Connect the yellow jumper wire from j3 to i29.

views.name: Step 21c
views.caption: Connect the yellow jumper wire from j3 to i29.

views.name: Step 22
views.caption: Begin the front panel with the potentiometer. Pull the knob off the potentiometer's shaft.

views.name: Step 22c
views.caption: Begin the front panel with the potentiometer. Pull the knob off the potentiometer's shaft.

views.name: Step 23
views.caption: Unscrew the nut and take it off the potentiometer's shaft.

views.name: Step 23c
views.caption: Unscrew the nut and take it off the potentiometer's shaft.

views.name: Step 24
views.caption: Take the washer off the potentiometer's shaft.

views.name: Step 24c
views.caption: Take the washer off the potentiometer's shaft.

views.name: Step 25
views.caption: Push the potentiometer's shaft through the round hole in F1 from the back, its little tab in the slot beside the hole.

views.name: Step 25c
views.caption: Push the potentiometer's shaft through the round hole in F1 from the back, its little tab in the slot beside the hole.

views.name: Step 26
views.caption: Put the washer back on the shaft against F1.

views.name: Step 26c
views.caption: Put the washer back on the shaft against F1.

views.name: Step 27
views.caption: Put the nut back on the shaft, and tighten it against F1.

views.name: Step 27c
views.caption: Put the nut back on the shaft, and tighten it against F1.

views.name: Step 28
views.caption: Put the knob back on the shaft, pushing it all the way on.

views.name: Step 28c
views.caption: Put the knob back on the shaft, pushing it all the way on.

views.name: Step 29
views.caption: Lay F1 face down beside the end of the base, as shown, with the potentiometer at the end nearer the breadboard.

views.name: Step 29c
views.caption: Lay F1 face down beside the end of the base, as shown, with the potentiometer at the end nearer the breadboard.

views.name: Step 30
views.caption: Connect the potentiometer's red wire to (+) red.

views.name: Step 30c
views.caption: Connect the potentiometer's red wire to (+) red.

views.name: Step 31
views.caption: Connect the potentiometer's tan wire to a5.

views.name: Step 31c
views.caption: Connect the potentiometer's tan wire to a5.

views.name: Step 32
views.caption: Connect the potentiometer's black wire to (-) blue.

views.name: Step 32c
views.caption: Connect the potentiometer's black wire to (-) blue.

views.name: Step 33
views.caption: Lay the alarm buzzer beside the base, past the end of the breadboard. Connect the buzzer's red wire to j4.

views.name: Step 33c
views.caption: Lay the alarm buzzer beside the base, past the end of the breadboard. Connect the buzzer's red wire to j4.

views.name: Step 34
views.caption: Connect the buzzer's black wire to (-) blue.

views.name: Step 34c
views.caption: Connect the buzzer's black wire to (-) blue.

views.name: Step 35
views.caption: Lay the LCD screen face down beside the base. Then peel four wires off the ribbon of male-female wires and lay them side by side.

views.name: Step 35c
views.caption: Lay the LCD screen face down beside the base. Then peel four wires off the ribbon of male-female wires and lay them side by side.

views.name: Step 36
views.caption: Connect the purple wire from GND on the LCD screen to (-) blue.

views.name: Step 36c
views.caption: Connect the purple wire from GND on the LCD screen to (-) blue.

views.name: Step 37
views.caption: Connect the yellow wire from VCC on the LCD screen to (+) red.

views.name: Step 37c
views.caption: Connect the yellow wire from VCC on the LCD screen to (+) red.

views.name: Step 38
views.caption: Connect the teal wire from SDA on the LCD screen to b8.

views.name: Step 38c
views.caption: Connect the teal wire from SDA on the LCD screen to b8.

views.name: Step 39
views.caption: Connect the blue wire from SCL on the LCD screen to b9.

views.name: Step 39c
views.caption: Connect the blue wire from SCL on the LCD screen to b9.

views.name: Step 40
views.caption: Plug the USB cable's small end into the Nano Board's USB socket.

views.name: Step 40c
views.caption: Plug the USB cable's small end into the Nano Board's USB socket.

views.name: Step 41
views.caption: Push the two F7s down into the slots in F3 by the end of the breadboard, their engraved sides facing out.

views.name: Step 41c
views.caption: Push the two F7s down into the slots in F3 by the end of the breadboard, their engraved sides facing out.

views.name: Step 42
views.caption: Spread the tops of the two F7s apart.

views.name: Step 42c
views.caption: Spread the tops of the two F7s apart.

views.name: Step 43
views.caption: Lower the buzzer in between the two F7s, its ears into their slots.

views.name: Step 43c
views.caption: Lower the buzzer in between the two F7s, its ears into their slots.

views.name: Step 44
views.caption: Let go of the two F7s, so that they close on the buzzer.

views.name: Step 44c
views.caption: Let go of the two F7s, so that they close on the buzzer.

views.name: Step 45
views.caption: Push F9 down into the slots in F3 beside the end of the breadboard, its engraved side towards that end.
views.review: The published guide hooks F9 in tilted and then stands it up (Steps 45, 46); in the CAD it goes straight down into its slots, so it does here. Does the real part need the hook-and-swing?

views.name: Step 45c
views.caption: Push F9 down into the slots in F3 beside the end of the breadboard, its engraved side towards that end.
views.review: The published guide hooks F9 in tilted and then stands it up (Steps 45, 46); in the CAD it goes straight down into its slots, so it does here. Does the real part need the hook-and-swing?

views.name: Step 46
views.caption: Move F1 round to the other end of the base and lay it face up there.

views.name: Step 46c
views.caption: Move F1 round to the other end of the base and lay it face up there.

views.name: Step 47
views.caption: Lift F4, with the switch, over the frame.

views.name: Step 47c
views.caption: Lift F4, with the switch, over the frame.

views.name: Step 48
views.caption: Lower F4 onto the tabs of the F7s and F9.

views.name: Step 48c
views.caption: Lower F4 onto the tabs of the F7s and F9.

views.name: Step 49
views.caption: Slide F8 into the slots in F4 and F3 from the front.

views.name: Step 49c
views.caption: Slide F8 into the slots in F4 and F3 from the front.

views.name: Step 50
views.caption: Stand the LCD screen up, face to the front, and bring it into the front of the case.

views.name: Step 50c
views.caption: Stand the LCD screen up, face to the front, and bring it into the front of the case.

views.name: Step 51
views.caption: Slide the LCD screen along until its board goes into the notches in F9.

views.name: Step 51c
views.caption: Slide the LCD screen along until its board goes into the notches in F9.

views.name: Step 52
views.caption: Stand F1 up in front of the case, the knob on the outside.

views.name: Step 52c
views.caption: Stand F1 up in front of the case, the knob on the outside.

views.name: Step 53
views.caption: Push F1 onto the tabs of F4 and F3.

views.name: Step 53c
views.caption: Push F1 onto the tabs of F4 and F3.
